summary: The same bulletin sets credit accident and sickness rates for the three-year period beginning January 1, 2027 by adjustment factors applied to the 2024-2026 prima facie rates, rounded to the nearest cent: 0.85 for 14-day coverage (a 15% decrease) and 1.35 for 30-day coverage (a 35% increase), retroactive and nonretroactive alike. Reading 'existing' as the rates in force is the owner's interpretation. Headline rates shown are the 36-month single premium rates from the 2027 table.
